title: Popsicle Curator
description: A modpack based around building and collecting
body:
![An orange title in style of Minecraft reading the following: Popsicle Curators - Neoforge 1.21.1 Modpack by DigitalPopsicle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/meLwninP/images/e6d5860535570af558e8b245849f7f75d9aacc64.png)

A modpack based around building and collecting. Explore new biomes, collect different weapons and artifacts, and build with new decoration blocks.

Featuring these main mods:
- Create
- Farmer's Delight
- Biomes O Plenty
- Chipped
- Tectonic
- Tide 2
- Xaero's
- Vista
- Exposure
- Spartan Weaponry
- Immersive Airships

This modpack has been made for use on a personal server and does not feature any mods that add structures.

If you want more structures to explore, I recommend adding structures by [YUNGNICKYOUNG](https://modrinth.com/user/YUNGNICKYOUNG), [Lupin](https://modrinth.com/user/lupin), and [Lukidonu](https://modrinth.com/user/lukidonu).
